title: Object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face by creating a closed loop with four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0295, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0295, 0.0) and ends at (0.0295, 0.0295). The third line starts at (0.0295, 0.0295) and ends at (0.0, 0.0295). The fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.0295) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scaling factor of 0.0295 to the entire sketch to ensure uniform dimensions. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional model. Set the extrusion depth towards the normal to 0.75 meters and the extrusion depth opposite the normal to 0.0 meters. This operation results in a new solid body. The final object is a vertical, cylindrical structure with a pointed tip at the bottom, resembling a stylized representation of a pen or pencil. The length and width of the base are both 0.02952755905511811 meters, and the height is 0.75 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0295, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0295, 0.0295) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0295) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
